parameters.name: num_cities
parameters.description: Number of cities in the tour problem

parameters.name: start_city
parameters.description: Designated start and end city index

parameters.name: travel_costs
parameters.description: Matrix of direct travel costs from city i to city j

parameters.name: visit_requirements
parameters.description: Required visit count for each city

variables.name: route
variables.description: City visited at each route position, including repeated start city at the final position

variables.name: selected_arcs
variables.description: Binary indicator of whether direct travel from city i to city j is used in the tour

variables.name: total_distance
variables.description: Total distance of the selected closed tour

auxiliary_variables.name: mtz_order
auxiliary_variables.description: MTZ ordering variables used to eliminate subtours in the selected tour

auxiliary_variables.name: route_assignment
auxiliary_variables.description: Binary assignment variable indicating whether city i is placed at route position k

auxiliary_variables.name: route_position_order
auxiliary_variables.description: MTZ ordering variables used to eliminate subtours in the selected tour

constraints.name: single_continuous_closed_tour
constraints.description: The selected arcs must form one continuous closed tour over all cities
constraints.formula: Selected arcs form a single cycle through all cities

constraints.name: respect_visit_requirements
constraints.description: The tour must respect the required visit count for each city
constraints.formula: visit count for each city follows r[i]

constraints.name: no_disconnected_subtours
constraints.formula: No subtours disconnected from the main tour

constraints.name: binary_selected_arcs
constraints.description: The arc selection variables are binary

constraints.name: integer_route_positions
constraints.description: The route position variable takes city indices as integers
constraints.formula: route[k] is an integer city index

constraints.name: nonnegative_total_distance
constraints.description: The total tour distance is nonnegative

constraints.name: asymmetric_travel_costs_allowed
constraints.description: The travel cost matrix may be asymmetric and direct travel costs are taken from D

constraints.name: fix_total_distance_definition
constraints.description: Define the total distance as the sum of costs over all selected arcs.

constraints.name: one_outgoing_arc_per_city
constraints.description: Each city has exactly one outgoing selected arc in the tour.

constraints.name: one_incoming_arc_per_city
constraints.description: Each city has exactly one incoming selected arc in the tour.

constraints.name: route_positions_are_a_permutation_of_cities
constraints.description: Each city must appear exactly once in the route positions using assignment variables to keep the formulation linear.
constraints.formula: \sum_{k=0}^{N-1} y_{ik} = 1 \quad \forall i \in \{0,\ldots,N-1\},\qquad \sum_{i=0}^{N-1} y_{ik} = 1 \quad \forall k \in \{0,\ldots,N-1\},\qquad \pi_k = \sum_{i=0}^{N-1} i\, y_{ik} \quad \forall k \in \{0,\ldots,N-1\}

constraints.name: forbid_self_loops
constraints.description: No city may be traveled to itself.

constraints.name: mtz_order_bounds
constraints.description: Bounds on MTZ ordering variables for non-start cities.

constraints.name: fix_start_city_mtz_order
constraints.description: Anchor the MTZ order at the start city to support a consistent ordering scale.

constraints.name: visit_each_city_exactly_once_by_route_positions
constraints.description: Each city must be visited exactly once in the closed tour via route positions.

constraints.name: route_positions_linked_to_assignment_variables
constraints.description: Each route position is linked to a unique city through assignment variables.

constraints.name: mtz_subtour_elimination
constraints.description: Prevent disconnected subtours by enforcing Miller-Tucker-Zemlin ordering constraints on non-start cities.
constraints.formula:
u_i - u_j + N x_{ij} \leq N-1 \quad  orall i,j \in \{0,\ldots,N-1\},\; i 
eq j,\; i 
eq s,\; j 
eq s

constraints.name: route_starts_and_ends_at_start_city_and_order_anchor
constraints.description: The route must start and end at the designated start city, and the MTZ order is anchored at the start city.

objectives.name: total_travel_distance_minimization
objectives.description: Minimize the total travel distance of the complete closed tour

final_objective.description: Minimize the total travel distance of the closed tour. This is a single-objective TSP-style model, so no objective combination is needed.
